summary:
I moved the public site to the Papier look, in English and French, light and dark. The header has the logo with its three lines drawing in once, then Product, Use cases menu, Connectors, Security, Pricing and Documentation. Next come the theme button, "Create a workspace", and "Sign in" to its right. The footer keeps the language choice and the "stop animations" switch.

The home, pricing, security and connectors pages follow the prototype. On those pages, answers highlight only words taken from their sources, and each sheet shows its source stack with flags. The connector catalogue keeps its search, families and empty states, with what Leon reads from each tool. Pricing has its table on a sheet, then "in every plan" and the FAQ. Security has two rules (shared with the team, private to you), then what is in place and what is in progress.

The Product, Use cases, team and Documentation pages use the same components and spacing. I drew nothing new for them.

The old effects (3D, particles, word splitting, tilt) and the old site CSS files are deleted. Motion is CSS only and stops under reduced motion and with the footer switch. Nothing is committed.

In this last pass I also fixed three things:
- The second button no longer runs off the page at 1280 wide (Product page hero).
- A date like "15 nov." no longer splits across two lines.
- A full stop after a source number no longer starts a new line on its own.
- I removed the "42 connectors" count from the Product capture panel.
